newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc rises on Rorer forecast.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc rises on Rorer forecast.

text.p: Shares in Rhone-Poulenc rose in morning trading on Tuesday after its Rhone-Poulenc Rorer unit forecast double-digit results growth, dealers said.
Rhone-Poulenc gained 0.94 percent to 139.7 francs at 1035 GMT.
The stock rose on Monday after brokerage Cholet Dupont raised its recommendation on Rhone-Poulenc to Buy from Accumulate.

Tim Rothwell, the managing director of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer said at a news conference that "new products, new indications and formulas will contribute some two billion dollars to our sales between now and 2000."

"The health sector makes one third of Rhone-Poulenc results and Rhone-Poulenc Rorer over 55 percent. The impact of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer on the results of the parent company is therefore significant," one analyst said.
One analyst said he expected profit at Rhone-Poulenc Rorer to rise by 16 percent in 1996 and 20 percent in the following two years.
